title: Fix Aggregator Abbau Aufbau Example Crash
description: The Entwerfen mit Bestand Aggregator should always show its introduction tour after the window is refreshed. Currently the first-run-seen flag is persisted in localStorage so the tour only auto-starts once per device. Make the Aggregator brand always replay the tour on every load/refresh (clean long-term brand-level policy, not a one-off hack).
summary: Fixed Chrome error-code-5 crashes when loading/selecting Abbau Aufbau. The LOD world grid grew GridHelper divisions without a cap; grazing camera frustums requested millions of cells and OOM-killed the tab. Capped divisions at 2048 and coarsen stepWorld for huge footprints instead. Unit tests cover the clamp and grazing camera; Aggregator select/reload stayed alive in Playwright.
